name: narrow neck bottle
caption: A narrow neck bottle with a sealed base, straight walls and one narrow neck. A sealed base carries continuous walls; the shoulder narrows into a neck. Circular walls keep an even thickness and the neck stays continuous with the shoulder. Overall width is 1.00 times depth; height is 1.00 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous cyan, white, near black color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
